headings.classes: font-black bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-blue-100 to-gray-400 drop-shadow-[0_2px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] tracking-tight

visual_enhancers.sparkle_effect: Absolute positioned small divs with glowing radial gradients or framer-motion particles to simulate sparkles and lens flare.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use radial-gradient blobs in the background to create subtle neon illumination (e.g., bg-[#4CC9F0]/10 blur-[120px] rounded-full absolute).

navigation.layout: Flex container, logo left, nav items right. Include 'Book Now' pill button.

hero.layout: Min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden
hero.elements: Background dark with subtle cyan glowing orbs. Main metallic heading, subtext, and a glowing neon cyan CTA button. Floating water droplet imagery or logo.

services_section.layout: Bento Grid or responsive 3-column CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 p-12).
services_section.card_style: Glassmorphism cards with padding p-8. Default border border-white/10. On hover, apply neon_glow_hover.
services_section.icons: Use Lucide-react icons (e.g., Droplet, Sparkles, Wind, Shield) colored in #4CC9F0.

gallery_showcase.layout: Masonry or Bento grid using abstract dark/water images to represent cleanliness and luxury.
gallery_showcase.images: Use the provided water droplet and abstract neon images with heavy rounded corners (rounded-3xl) and subtle hover scaling.

contact_and_booking.layout: Two-column grid. Left: Contact details. Right: Booking form.

contact_info.style: Large typography, neon icons, metallic text.

contact_and_booking.form_style: Shadcn components customized. Inputs with bg-white/5, border-white/20, text-white, focus:border-[#4CC9F0] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4CC9F0]. Submit button with solid cyan background, metallic glow.

brand_logo.description: Circular metallic silver/blue badge logo with ACT QBN Carpet Cleaning text, water droplet icon, glowing blue orbital rings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`.
Add 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts to public/index.html or import them in index.css.
Set the root background color to `#0B1320` in index.css and text color to `#E0F2FE`.
Create custom utility classes in index.css for the metallic text and neon glowing borders so they are easily reusable.
Implement the Contact Info and Booking Form in a dual-column layout. Use custom styled standard inputs (or shadcn if installed) styled with glassmorphism.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="booking-submit-button"`).
Use framer-motion to create floating sparkle elements in the hero background to match the 'subtle lens flare/sparkle effects' requirement.
The overall vibe MUST be premium, dark, and futuristic, strictly adhering to the #0B1320 and #4CC9F0 palette. Avoid any default white/gray SaaS looks.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
